heading: Which students are ready for Friday’s band trip?
lead: When the bus leaves Friday morning, you need to know who is going, whose permission slip is missing, and which families still have a balance.
caption: Sample band program showing trip readiness in Event HQ.

steps.heading: Invite the right group
steps.body: Choose the ensemble and make the trip optional when families need to opt in. Start with the students who are actually going.

steps.heading: Follow up on one missing item
steps.body: A student can have a signed form and still owe a fee. Check both before sending the family a reminder.

steps.heading: Make your departure list
steps.body: Review outstanding items in Event HQ before rehearsal ends so you can follow up before the buses arrive.
